customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as env vars in workflows, marked with a renovate annotation comment. Covers the curl-a-release-tarball installs (just, wasm-pack) and the cargo-installed worker-build, which no built-in manager can see.

packageRules.description: Cargo on its own PR, separate from the web/ npm tree.
npm (web/ and shout-worker/) on its own PR.
worker (Cargo.toml) and worker-build (ci.yml) move together: worker-build checks the worker crate's wasm-bindgen version.
